name: @fantechlabs/skills
description: Shared agent skills and CLI for Fantech engineering practices

scripts.check: vp check src tests skills/commit/scripts skills/claude-workflow/scripts skills/release/scripts skills/changeset/scripts bin package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && vp run typecheck
scripts.lint: vp lint src tests skills/commit/scripts skills/claude-workflow/scripts skills/release/scripts skills/changeset/scripts vite.config.ts
scripts.format: vp fmt src tests skills/commit/scripts skills/claude-workflow/scripts skills/release/scripts skills/changeset/scripts bin package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: vp fmt src tests skills/commit/scripts skills/claude-workflow/scripts skills/release/scripts skills/changeset/scripts bin package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts --check
scripts.precommit: vp run lint && vp run format:check
scripts.ci:test: vp run check && vp test && vp run test:bun-smoke
